notes.title: Khor-Vain | Beta Card Reveal
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42470463/b96257143b2bf731fd8b2e125c7fbd58f3662ed8.jpg[/img]

Khor-Vain is one of the most powerful earth cards from the principal set for two reasons: 

1. It’s a Mercenaries card, so you can include it in any of your squads that has a hero capable of equipping terrains. 
2. Its skill, “Power of the Chosen Ones 2” gives all its heroes and mercenaries cards +2 attack while this card remains on the battlefield.
